description: [lenders] Checklist for tracing charged-off accounts from the originator through each transfer to the current seller. Answer yes/no/unknown per item and give the number of known transfers; returns status, open questions, and the Don of Debt chain-of-title guide. A document-consistency review, not a legal conclusion.

account_references_reconcile.description: Account references reconcile across schedules and the current tape

assignment_each_transfer.description: Assignment documents for each known transfer

bill_of_sale_each_transfer.description: Bill of sale for each known transfer

entity_changes_documented.description: Name changes, mergers, or successor entities documented

gaps_explained.description: Any apparent gaps explained in writing for counsel review

known_transfers.description: Number of known transfers after origination

originator_identified.description: Originator (original creditor) identified for the pool

schedule_or_exhibit.description: Schedule, exhibit, or account-level extract tied to each transfer document

transfer_dates_consistent.description: Transfer and effective dates consistent across documents
